clues.it: Fabio era nella 3ª colonna e nella 1ª riga, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 3rd column and in the 1st row, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Rosa era in una stanza diversa da Luca e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Rosa was in a different room from Luca and on the Deck.

clues.it: Tea era nella 3ª riga, seduta su una sedia e a nord di Vito.
clues.en: Tea was in the 3rd row, sitting on a chair and north of Vito.

clues.it: Luca era a nord di Nino e in Stiva.
clues.en: Luca was north of Nino and in the Hold.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 5ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Tea.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 5th row and in the same room as Tea.

clues.it: Vito era nella 2ª colonna e accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Vito was in the 2nd column and beside a life ring.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Anna era seduta su una sedia e in Stiva.
clues.en: Anna was sitting on a chair and in the Hold.

clues.it: Nino era nella 6ª colonna, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Nino was in the 6th column, but was not beside a barrel.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 8ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 5th.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Sergio con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Sergio's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 5th, column 9th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 8ª riga: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 8th row: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 4th, column 8th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 8ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 8th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 9th, column 6th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 5ª colonna: escludendola, a Rosa resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Rosa a single square: row 2nd, column 4th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 1ª colonna, e lì a Giada resta una sola casella libera: la 7ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 1st column, and it leaves Giada a single free square there: the 7th row.
